patterns.client_components: Components with interactivity use 'use client' directive at the top
patterns.mobile_menu_pattern: Dashboard uses hamburger button + backdrop overlay + slide-in sidebar with transform translate-x
patterns.icon_pattern: Inline SVG icons (no external library like heroicons)
patterns.responsive_hiding: Use Tailwind classes like 'hidden md:flex' and 'lg:hidden'
patterns.language: Turkish UI (Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap, etc.)
